message: "shop.audit" is not a resource this agent can read: it does not exist, or the agent has no access to it

nextSteps.text: Search for the resource by name: it may be spelled differently or sit in another namespace.
Tell the person the resource was not found or is not granted to you, and ask whether you should have it.
Tell the agent to add the resource once you decide it should have it, or which resource to use instead.
When the person tells you to add it, run this and show them the link it prints, where they grant the resource.

personMessage: The agent asked for a resource it cannot see: it does not exist, or the agent may not read it. An agent uses one database; a resource in another database needs its own agent. To give the agent a resource, tell it: it gives you a link where you pick the resources.
